explication: This repository is primarily a Chinese programming-learning knowledge base, presented as an online reference for Java and broader software topics, with learning routes, interview preparation, and an Agent-focused question-and-video collection. The principal user flow is to choose a subject or preparation route, read its lessons or interview material, and follow linked explanations and videos. The tree also contains a Remotion sample composition; its rendering components are shown as a separate internal example, not assumed to power the knowledge-base videos. Relationships reflect README statements and the sampled Remotion imports.
